### CurrencyPicker.Options

<ParamField body="Options.className" type="string">
  Class applied to the options wrapper div.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.disabled" type="boolean" default="false">
  Additionally disables search and every currency option. Root disabled state always takes precedence.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.emptyLabel" type="ReactNode" default="No results">
  Content announced when no currencies match. Defaults to No results.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.listLabel" type="string">
  Accessible name for the selection listbox. Defaults to the registered Dropdown title or trigger name. Native accessible attributes on Options target only its wrapper.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.ref" type="Ref&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;">
  Ref to the options wrapper div, or the element composed through render.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, {}&gt;">
  Replaces the non-interactive wrapper div. Forward the supplied props and ref when rendering a custom component. Use searchProps.render to customize the input.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.searchable" type="boolean" default="true">
  Renders a search input above the options. Defaults to true.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.searchLabel" type="string" default="Search">
  Search placeholder and accessible name. Defaults to Search.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.searchProps" type="DropdownSearchProps">
  Native input attributes, ref, render, and controlled or uncontrolled query props forwarded to Dropdown.Search. Use value with onValueChange or defaultValue.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.style" type="CSSProperties">
  Inline styles applied to the options wrapper div.
</ParamField>
